state.screen: Select a Challenge Theme / Living Legends; six visible car thumbnails

parser.transfer_event_record: event id 0; one-byte GIF path, little-endian u32 record size, then bounded GIF bytes
parser.tag_fields: GIFtag low64 NLOOP[0:14], EOP15, FLG58:59, NREG60:63 (zero means 16); high64 REGS descriptors; IMAGE FLG=2 carries NLOOP*16 payload bytes
parser.register_write_handling: Packed FLG=0 descriptors with register id A+D (0xE); A+D address is low byte of second qword. Retained BITBLTBUF (0x50), TRXPOS (0x51), TRXREG (0x52), TRXDIR (0x53) across the serialized stream. Transfer and GIF record sizes were bounds-checked.

target_upload.interpretation: A 32x32, 4096-byte PSMCT32 host-to-local transfer to GS base block 0x29dd is present in this captured screen state. This identifies GS transfer semantics/destination for the packet, not a source PTG descriptor or a visible icon binding.

source_comparison.caveat: The three 64-byte prefixes occur inside the identified IMAGE payload, but have no exact 4096-byte continuation and are not asset identifications. Existing raw exact search and aligned-origin PSMCT32 VRAM scan test untransformed source tile bytes; neither exhausts color/alpha remapping, alternate transfer coordinates/pitch, texture reuse, or crop/composition.

limits: This is a packet-level host-to-local transfer; it does not establish that the upload is one of the visible thumbnails.
No complete source tile matches this image payload under the raw unchanged-byte scan. No color/alpha transform has yet been source-proven for this specific transfer.
No PTG file-to-transfer descriptor join, full destination-tile join, or UI sprite draw-to-upload join has been proven from this dump.
The 3 64-byte prefixes are retained as negative/ambiguous evidence; do not identify them as tiles.

transformed_candidate_tests.candidate_universe: 3136 unique source tile bodies derived from all 171 archive-bound CARS/LIVERY PTGs; source tile is 32x32 RGBA bytes.

transform_set.alpha_rule: alpha mode is applied when the output alpha slot is sourced from the source alpha byte; all four positions/permutation forms otherwise remain byte permutations.

origin_test.method: Compare each source tile first 16 pixels after each tested transform to payload bytes 0..63.
origin_test.result: No complete 32x32 transformed tile can match at upload origin under this transform set because even the first 64 bytes fail.

displaced_prefix_test.method: Search each transformed 64-byte source-tile prefix throughout the 4096-byte payload at 4-byte-aligned offsets; source origin maps to pixel x=offset%128/4 and y=floor(offset/128).
displaced_prefix_test.note: Repeated prefix positions come from repeated pixel sequences in the payload; they are candidate locations, not distinct asset evidence.

crop_continuation_test.method: For candidates at offsets 1824 and 1952, place source tile pixel (0,0) at the matching upload pixel and compare every remaining in-bounds pixel using each matching RGB permutation. This tests the resulting 24x18 and 24x17 visible crops, 432 and 408 pixels.

results.first_mismatch: the first compared pixel after the matched 16-pixel prefix

crop_continuation_test.interpretation: The hit covers exactly a 16-pixel prefix; no matching cropped tile continuation was found.

limits: No source-derived runtime channel transform or alpha equation has been proved; this is an adversarial candidate search only.

Does not cover arbitrary color curves, alpha-test survival, per-component arithmetic other than alpha doubling/clamp, non-RGBA encodings, or source pixels whose tile origin is outside the 32x32 upload (arbitrary crop windows).
A prefix match remains ambiguous; do not promote it to an asset identity.

all_150_uploads.candidate_universe: All 150 32x32 PSMCT32 host-to-local IMAGE payloads from the menu98 dump; each 4096 bytes. Same 3136 unique source PTG tile bodies.

transform_set.alpha_rule: alpha mode is applied when the output alpha slot is sourced from the source alpha byte; all four positions/permutation forms otherwise remain byte permutations.

all_150_uploads.method: For each transformed source tile first-16-pixel (64-byte) prefix, index all unique pixel-aligned 64-byte windows in all 150 upload payloads. Every matching prefix candidate places source tile pixel (0,0) at that in-bounds payload coordinate; compare the entire remaining source-origin crop through the payload edge.
limits: This tests source-tile-origin placements with source-origin continuation, not arbitrary source crop origins outside the upload.
Only tested channel permutations and alpha modes are covered; arbitrary color/alpha arithmetic, alpha-test-dependent output, swizzle/twiddle transformations, and intermediate copies remain untested.
Prefix hit counts include many repeated candidate sequences and are not unique source-asset identifications.
